description: This source file defines extension methods for configuring CosmosDB-related options in the Orleans project. It provides methods to set default test configurations for clustering, grain storage, and reminder table options, and includes a helper method to create a CosmosClient with account key authentication.

classes.name: CosmosOptionsExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for setting default test configurations on various CosmosDB-related Orleans options classes.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (this CosmosClusteringOptions options)
methods.description: Configures the provided CosmosClusteringOptions instance with default test settings, either using AAD authentication or account key, and enables resource creation.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (this CosmosGrainStorageOptions options)
methods.description: Configures the provided CosmosGrainStorageOptions instance with default test settings, either using AAD authentication or account key, and enables resource creation.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (this CosmosReminderTableOptions options)
methods.description: Configures the provided CosmosReminderTableOptions instance with default test settings, either using AAD authentication or account key, and enables resource creation.

methods.name: GetCosmosClientUsingAccountKey ()
methods.description: A private helper method that returns a function creating a CosmosClient configured with account key authentication, including custom HTTP handler with disabled SSL validation, and Gateway connection mode.
